title: Lookup with SQL injection and off-by-one

findings.description: User input is concatenated into a SQL string, which allows SQL injection. Use a parameterized query instead.

before: const query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '" + userId + "'";
after: const user = db.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", [userId]);

findings.description: Loop uses `i <= scores.length`, so the final iteration reads past the end of the array (off-by-one).
